scope.implementedContract: For native ul/ol > li elements with unnamed, non-focusable native listitem AX nodes, direct inline phrasing children, direct focusable links, generated parenthesized metadata spans, and direct emphasis/static-text boundaries, emit a marker stop followed by AX-confirmed child-boundary stops instead of one flattened listitem name.
guards: native li only under native ul or ol
no explicit role, aria-label, aria-labelledby, tabindex/focusability, nav ancestor, aria-live, aria-disabled, hidden state, or marker-separated link-list shape
descendants exclude nested lists, tables/grids, buttons, form controls, controls, images, and block wrappers
requires at least one direct link, at least one generated parenthetical metadata element, and at least one emphasis boundary
requires AX listitem with empty name and non-focusable state, direct AX marker, AX-confirmed link names/order, and generated metadata text matching the DOM pseudo-parentheses span
does not inspect Royal Mail selectors, copy, classes, URLs, hrefs, file extensions, titles, PDF strings, or data-sr-candidate attributes
